name: IMPOSSIBLE Wall Hop Obby
desc:
Welcome to IMPOSSIBLE Wall Hop Obby! This game is a difficulty chart obby where the obstacles are primarily wall hops! Only 1% of players win! Can you beat the game without rage quitting?

CONTROLS (Computer, Console):
- Reset Character (R, Y)
- Shiftlock (Shift, LT)

scripts.features:
Features ⚡
⚡ Hyper-Fast Auto-Farm: Zips through every checkpoint in the obby with a customizable teleport delay (down to 0.01s).

🔄 Instant Hardware Rebirth: Uses high-precision VirtualInputManager to simulate real hardware mouse clicks on the Rebirth UI for 100% reliability.

🛒 Intelligent Auto-Shop: Automatically detects and purchases every item (Trails, Halos, etc.) from the shop as soon as you have enough coins.

📊 Live Status HUD: Real-time on-screen tracking showing your Current Stage, Coin Balance, and script Status (Farming vs. Rebirthing).

🛡️ Anti-Fall Protection: Advanced character anchoring logic that prevents falling through the map during the Rebirth transition.

👻 Permanent Noclip: Disables character collisions during flight to ensure you never get stuck on walls or obstacles.

☕ Anti-AFK Built-in: Prevents the Roblox idle kick, allowing you to farm overnight or while away from the keyboard.

🎚️ Dynamic UI (Rayfield): A clean, modern interface with sliders for speed control and separate toggles for farming and shopping.
